tytul: Moroccan harissa under oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Moroccan harissa, a paste of chili and garlic kept under a layer of olive oil.

ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
NCHFP research found that garlic-in-oil mixtures stored at room temperature are at risk of botulism.

akapity: Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for harissa under oil from a checked source.
